summary: Issue #559 MMU-11: intent-review spec_fidelity=pass consumed as given. Action Cards/Scoring is sole write owner for action_cards and legacy recommendations; GET /v1/recommendations delegates to persist_legacy_recommendations on the public action_cards facade with behavior-compatible lift to legacy_recommendations.py. Registry and MODULE docs agree; contract tests enforce no API-route RecommendationsRepo import or repo.create. Refresh→persist_scoring_result unchanged on owning module. 27 targeted unit tests pass; no reliability/security blockers.

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review convention note (non-blocking): legacy_recommendations.py imports RecommendationsRepo but MODULE.md Dependencies lists ActionCardsRepo only; Public API documents persist_legacy_recommendations.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Optional follow-up: add RecommendationsRepo under Dependencies for the retained legacy table path.

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review convention note (non-blocking): GET /v1/recommendations remains a read route that triggers owner persist on empty shop; now delegates to action_cards instead of inline repo.create — matches PRD reroute intent.
criticalFindings.suggestion: No action required; side-effect preserved and documented in api/MODULE.md.

criticalFindings.description: Guardrails: AST contract tests block RecommendationsRepo import and repo.create in the recommendations route source, but import-linter does not yet enforce non-owner repo imports from api/* at module boundary (RecommendationsRepo still reachable via database lazy re-export).
criticalFindings.suggestion: Optional MMU follow-up: extend import-linter contract to forbid api.routes.* importing repositories.repos write helpers.

criticalFindings.description: Empty-shop GET still runs synchronous persist_legacy_recommendations before re-listing rows — latency unchanged from pre-MMU-11 inline _refresh_recommendations behavior.
criticalFindings.suggestion: No action for MMU-11; consider async enqueue in a future deprecation slice if latency becomes a concern.

criticalFindings.description: Legacy recommendations table remains written alongside action_cards decision rows; ownership is now centralized but dual-table model persists until MMU-12+ deprecation.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Track in modular-monolith upgrade backlog; no MMU-11 blocker.
